severityDefinitions.High: Significant security weakness. Could be exploited to gain unauthorized access. Remediate within 1 week.
severityDefinitions.Medium: Security gap that weakens overall posture. Address within 30 days.
severityDefinitions.Low: Minor improvement opportunity. Address within 90 days or as part of regular maintenance.
severityDefinitions.Critical: Immediate risk of compromise. Exploitation could lead to complete system takeover or data breach. Remediate within 24-48 hours.
